experiment_data.notes: EVAL DONE. PR=0.38 (down from train 0.77), mean_ISR=0.07, proved_only_ISR=0.185. H7=0% by strict classifier BUT model generates degenerate uppercase pseudo-Prolog (e.g. MARY_IS_AN_AVADEOTE.) — not valid Prolog syntax. All 38 proved samples have n_necessary=1 (only the query-matching fact matters), ISR=1/n_clauses pattern. Functionally H7-like (conclusion duplication) but classifier misses it due to non-standard syntax. 1 sample had ISR=1.0 (single-clause). Different Goodhart pathway than s42 (which had 100% strict H7): s43 produces more clauses but they're all vacuous uppercase tokens. Confirms Claim 3 (Goodhart across logic types) but via degenerate syntax rather than clean conclusion duplication. DISK: 240G/250G (96%), only 11GB free — needs cleanup.
